description: Price, margin and markup in exact cents. Analyze a cost and a price (margin is profit / price, markup is profit / cost). Or set a price from a cost and a margin percent (price = cost / (1 − margin)), or from a markup percent (price = cost × (1 + markup)). Or walk a list of successive discounts off a price, rounding each step half away from zero to the cent. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/markup-margin
